Competitive substitution is measurable: Databricks' disclosed ARR milestones, Microsoft Fabric adoption, and the open-table-format (Iceberg) shift that lets customers keep data outside Snowflake's storage. Iceberg adoption is the structural bear case and it shows up in storage revenue before compute
Stock-based comp and share count: Snowflake's dilution and buyback interact; the 10-Q's share table is where non-GAAP-to-GAAP divergence widens
